name: Mahila Samruddhi (Gujarat Backward Caste Development Corporation)
benefit: 1. The maximum loan limit under this scheme is up to ₹1,25,000/-. 1. The interest rate on these schemes will be 4% per annum. 1. In these schemes, 95% of the unit cost will be provided as a loan, where 95% will be contributed by the National Corporation and 5% by the State Government. 1. This loan is to be repaid in 48 equal monthly installments, including interest.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be female. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to a socially and educationally backward class, specifically Other Backward Classes (OBC). 1. The total annual income of the applicant's family should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 and 45 years on the date of application. 1. The applicant must have experience in a business requiring technical and other skills.
